flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4103 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown.
Get the booking reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.

remark: click: Closing the cookie notice modal by clicking Close cookie notice button
click: Clicking Book a free first visit
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Your name"; type "Email address"; type "Visit date"
click: Clicking the climbing waiver acceptance checkbox
click: Clicking Confirm my free visit button
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the booking reference code from the booking confirmatio
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked a free first visit for Sam Rivera (sam@example.com) for November 2, 2026 at noon.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed and the reference code was saved: PL-4821.
